description: Guard (016 plan D10/D11, mutation f). A div block holds a comment opener with no closer before a blank line; raw HTML passes through, so the browser's comment runs on past the blank line to the digest marker's closing arrow. The digest on disk carries only the two markers outside the comment, so the check must say OK; harvesting the hidden marker would call this correct digest stale. D10 disarms an opener only outside raw HTML; without that exclusion the marker would be harvested. Since 016 phase 2 (plan D8 and D11 as amended during phase 2) the marker passed over inside the comment is also reported by DIGEST-020, so the run fails naming its line; a mutation that harvests it drops that report and reads the digest stale.
